name: 2-in-1 Foam Window Wiper & Glass Cleaner | Rubber Squeegee with Foam Sponge | Car Windshield, Mirror & Kitchen Glass Cleaning Brush
description:
Keep your glass surfaces spotless with the 2-in-1 Foam Window Wiper & Glass Cleaner. Combining a soft absorbent foam sponge with a durable rubber squeegee, this versatile cleaning tool effectively removes dust, dirt, water stains, and soap residue in one easy motion. The ergonomic handle provides a comfortable grip, while the compact design easily reaches corners and narrow spaces for streak-free cleaning. Perfect for windows, mirrors, shower doors, kitchen surfaces, car windshields, and other smooth glass surfaces, this reusable cleaning brush makes everyday cleaning quick and effortless.

Key Features
2-in-1 foam sponge and rubber squeegee design
Cleans and wipes glass in one easy motion
Soft foam sponge removes dirt and dust effectively
Rubber squeegee leaves streak-free, dry surfaces
Reaches corners and narrow spaces with ease
Comfortable ergonomic handle for better grip
Lightweight and easy to use
Reusable and easy to clean
Ideal for windows, mirrors, shower glass, car windshields, and kitchen surfaces
Suitable for home, office, and automotive cleaning

Product Specifications
Product Type: Foam Window Wiper & Glass Cleaner
Design: 2-in-1 Foam Sponge & Rubber Squeegee
Material: ABS Plastic, Foam & Rubber
Usage: Wet & Dry Cleaning
Color: Random Color

How to Use
Wet the foam sponge with water or glass cleaner
Wipe the glass surface to remove dirt and stains
Use the rubber squeegee to remove excess water
Clean from top to bottom for a streak-free finish
Wash the sponge after use and allow it to dry

Material / Composition
High-Quality ABS Plastic Handle
Soft Absorbent Foam Sponge
Durable Rubber Squeegee Blade

Safety Information
Rinse the sponge thoroughly after each use
Do not use abrasive cleaners on the foam
Store in a cool, dry place
Keep out of reach of children when not in use
Replace if the rubber blade becomes worn
